hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund work is incomplete. The signed batch requests refunds for orders 113 (7379 cents), 114 (8493 cents), and 115 (6651 cents), but list_refunds shows only 113 and 115 applied. Order 114's refund of 8493 cents is missing from the ledger, so customer net balances may be overstated. W2's 'Refunds are done' message is inconsistent with the ledger. No payouts have been recorded. Please have Alpha Co apply the order 114 refund and confirm before payouts resume.

reply.thought: The handoff lists three refunds requested but only two reported as applied; order 114 ($84.93) is missing. I'll check the ledger's refund records before deciding whether to hold.
